deliver.paidConfirm: This order was already paid by card. Mark it as delivered?

payment.codHint: Pay the seller in cash when the order arrives.

payment.testMode: Test mode: no real money is charged.

state.failedHint: No money was taken. You can try again or pay cash on delivery.

seller.cod: Cash on delivery: collect the total when you deliver.
seller.refunded: The buyer's electronic payment was refunded.

errors.ORDER_AMOUNT_NOT_PAYABLE: This order's amount can't be paid electronically. You can pay cash on delivery.
